title: Imperfect Subjunctive (Pretérito Imperfecto de Subjuntivo)
description: Express hypothetical actions, wishes, or conditions in the past using the imperfect subjunctive (-ra/-se forms).

grammar.title: Imperfect Subjunctive (Pretérito Imperfecto de Subjuntivo)
grammar.content:
The imperfect subjunctive expresses hypothetical actions, wishes, or conditions in the past. There are two valid sets of endings (-ra and -se) that are interchangeable in meaning; the -ra forms are more common in speech.

How to form it:
1. Start with the 3rd-person plural preterite (ellos/ellas/Uds.)
2. Drop the -ron ending
3. Add -ra or -se endings

-RA endings (more common):
- yo: -ra
- tú: -ras
- él/ella/usted: -ra
- nosotros: -ramos
- vosotros: -rais
- ellos/ellas/ustedes: -ran

-SE endings (alternative, more formal):
- yo: -se
- tú: -ses
- él/ella/usted: -se
- nosotros: -semos
- vosotros: -seis
- ellos/ellas/ustedes: -sen

Examples:
- caminaron → camin- → caminara/caminase
- hablaron → habl- → hablara/hablase
- comieron → comie- → comiera/comiese
- vivieron → vivie- → viviera/viviese

Key irregulars:
- tener → tuvieron → tuviera/tuviese
- ser/ir → fueron → fuera/fuese
- estar → estuvieron → estuviera/estuviese
- poder → pudo → pudiera/pudiese
- saber → supo → supiera/supiese
- hacer → hizo → hiciera/hiciese
examples: Si tuviera dinero, viajaría por Sudamérica. (If I had money, I would travel through South America.)
Espero que vinieras a la fiesta. (I hope you came to the party.)
Quería que nos explicaras la regla. (I wanted you to explain the rule to us.)
Si pudiera, viajaría a Japón. (If I could, I would travel to Japan.)
Era necesario que ellos estuvieran disponibles. (It was necessary that they be available.)
grammar.aid_note: Romanian Conjunctiv (subjunctive) also has imperfect/hypothetical forms. The Spanish -ra form actually derives from the Latin pluperfect indicative. In Romanian, 'aș vorbi' (I would speak) is closer to Spanish conditional, but the subjunctive trigger structures are analogous. Romanian imperfect subjunctive: 'să vorbesc', 'să vorbești' — the Spanish -ra form is structurally closer to the Latin root.

pronunciation.title: Stress in Imperfect Subjunctive Forms
pronunciation.content:
All imperfect subjunctive forms carry stress on the ending syllable:

-RA forms:
- yo: hablara (ha-BLA-ra) — stress on 'ra'
- tú: hablaras (ha-BLA-raz) — stress on 'ra'
- él/ella/usted: hablara (ha-BLA-ra) — stress on 'ra'
- nosotros: habláramos (ha-BLA-za-MOS) — stress on 'á'
- vosotros: hablarais (ha-BLA-ra-is) — stress on 'ra'
- ellos: hablaran (ha-BLA-ran) — stress on 'ra'

The nosotros and vosotros forms carry accent marks because the stress falls on the syllable before the ending.

The -se forms follow the same stress pattern but use -se/-ses/-se/-semos/-seis/-sen endings.

Critical: Spanish 'comiera' is pronounced 'ko-MYE-ra' (three distinct syllables), NOT 'ko-MIRA' as English speakers might assume. The 'ie' is a diphthong but the 'a' at the end is a separate syllable.
pronunciation.aid_note: Romanian vowel pronunciation is very similar to Spanish — pure vowels without diphthongs. The main challenge is the Spanish imperfect subjunctive stress patterns. Romanian has similar stress patterns on verb endings.

exercises.question: Complete with the imperfect subjunctive (-ra) of TENER: Si yo ____ más tiempo, viajaría más.
exercises.explanation: From the preterite 'ellos tuvieron' → remove -ron → 'tuvie-' → add -ra endings. 'Si yo tuviera más tiempo' = If I had more time.

exercises.question: Complete with the imperfect subjunctive (-se) of SER: Ella quería que yo ____ más paciente.
exercises.explanation: From the preterite 'ellos fueron' → remove -ron → 'fue-' → add -se endings. 'Fuese' is the alternative (more formal) imperfect subjunctive form.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses the imperfect subjunctive correctly?
exercises.explanation: Hypothetical 'if' clauses in the past require the imperfect subjunctive: 'Si yo tuviera dinero, viajaría.' The -ra form is the standard for hypotheticals.

exercises.question: Complete with the imperfect subjunctive of ESTAR (-ra form): Era necesario que ellos ____ (estar) disponibles.
exercises.explanation: From preterite 'estuvieron' → 'estuvie-' + '-ran' = 'estuvieran'. 'Era necesario que ellos estuvieran disponibles' = It was necessary that they be available.

exercises.question: Complete with the imperfect subjunctive of IR (-ra form): Si ____ (ir) a España, conocería a mucha gente.
exercises.explanation: IR shares the same preterite stem as SER (fueron → fue-). Imperfect subjunctive (-ra): 'fuera' for yo/él/ella/usted.

exercises.question: Conjugate TENER in the imperfect subjunctive (-ra form):
exercises.explanation: TENER is irregular in the preterite (tuvieron), which is the stem source for the imperfect subjunctive. From 'tuvieron' → 'tuvie-' + endings.
